content: Caín Abeljai pachisa augmattsamu
Adánka nuwe Eva ejapjukui, nunik pujus tsawanji jegajim aishmagkun uchigmakui, nunik adaikauwai Caín. Nunak: “Makichik uchin aishmagkun uchigmakjai, junak Apajuí minak sujuse”, taku tiuwai.
Duwi pujus Eva tikichin uchin Abelan Caígka yachin uchigmakui. Abelak uwijan kuitamajakui, untsu Caín ajakan ajakbau aajakui.
Kuashat tsawan nagkaemakiu ai, makichik tsawantai, Caín Apajuí anentag susatnun ajaka nejen juuka juki ejentauwai.
Tuja Abelchakam makichik uwig yama nagkamchak petsakbau shiig duwegman achika juki Apajuín emematak ejetiuwai. Dutikamtai Apajuí Abelnak shiig anenjauwai, nuadui Abeldaunak shiig anentus jukiuwai.
Untsu Caígnak shiig anenjachui, tuja nii anentag susamunashkam shiig anentsag jujukchauwai. Dutikam Caín senchi kajekui, nunik kajekbautak wekagu.
Nunittaman Apajuí chichajak: “¿Wagka imanika kajekmesh wekaeme?
Amesh pegkeg takakmek, shiig aneasam wekaemainaitme, amek nuniatsum duwi amina tudaujum wagagtamkittak awagtamui. Tujash amek tudauwa duka depetmainaitme”, tiuwai.
Makichik tsawantai Caín yachin chichajak: “Ajanum wemi” tusa yachin juki weuwai. Nunik atushat akanak yachi Abelan mauwai.
Dutika yachin maamtai, Apajuí Caígkan chichajak: “¿Dusha amina yatsum Abelash wajukame?” tusa tama, Caín ayaak: “Achah, wikaitag mina yatsuju kuitamnun”, tiuwai.
Tutai Apajuí chichajak: “¿Wagka yatsumesh aikaume? Ame yatsum maakum numpe nugkanum ukagbauwa nunú mina untsujui, suwimak susata tusa.
Nuadui amek shiig pegkegchaunum juwaktatme, juju nugka yatsumi numpe ukagbaun uwaja nunú nugkanmak amek pujuschattame.
Ajakak ajattame, tujash tsapaishtatui. Emetnaja pujamugmek atsugtamtinai, ayatak wainkam tikich nugkanum wekaetinaitme, imaniakmesh ame pujusa ayamainuk igkugchatnaitme”, tiuwai.
Tusa tama Caín Apajuín ayaak: “Mina suwimkajuk shiig katsunmainchawap atatua.
Yamaik juju nugkanmak ajapjame, nuadui wi amijai pujamunak idaikun, tikich nugkanum machikish ayamtsuk wainkan wekaetatjai, nuni wekagai mina yaki igkunkat nunú minak mantuatin ati”, tiuwai.
Tutai Apajuí chichajak: “Aents amina mantamuk, sieteya imania suwimkan jukiagtinai”, tiuwai. Nuna tusa Apajuí Caígka iyashin maam amainchau apujtus akupkauwai.
Dutikam nii pujusa Apajuíjai chichasbaunak ukuak Nod nugkanum wee pujusui. Nod nugkak Edégnum wajasa diismak etsa minitaiya nuni aajakui.
Caín wegantu aidau
Caígka nuwe ejapjuk aishmagkun uchigmakui, dutika Enoc adaikauwai. Dutikamtai Caín nuwi yaaktan najana niina uchiji daajin Enoc adaikauwai.
Tuja Enoc akiauwai Irad. Irad akiauwai Mehujael, Mehujael akiauwai Metusael, Metusael akiauwai Lámec.
Lámec jimag nuwan: Adá daagtinun, Silá daagtinjai nuwatkauwai.
Adá uchigmakui Jabalan. Tuja Jabal wegantu aidauk aakchinum batsamin, tagkun kuitamin aajaku ainawai.
Jabala yachi aajakui Jubal. Nuna uchiji wegantu aidauk arpan awatin, pigkui umpuin aajaku ainawai.
Siláshkam uchigmakui Tubal-caín. Nigka jiju bronce, hierro aina nuna najanajaku aidaun apaji aajakui. Tubal-caígka umayi aajakui Naamá.
Lámec niina nuwe aidaun chichajak:

content.text: Makichik aents mantuatag tusa ijutkui wi maamjai.
Caígka mauk sieteya imania suwimka jukitnai tibauwai.
Tuja mina mantauk setenta y sieteya imania

content: Adán niina nuwe Evayai uchiji kampatuma nuna akiamu
Adánka nuwe ataktu ejapjuk uchi aishmagkun uchigmakui, dutika adaikauwai Set. Nunak: “Mina uchig Abelan Caín mauwa duwi minak juna Apajuí sujuse”, taku tiuwai.
Setchakam makichik uchin akia adaikauwai Enós. Duwi nagkamas aents aidauk Apajuín emematuinak niina daajin adaitus segajaku ainawai.
